item.title: Open-weight AI model Kimi K3 completes simulated network attack
item.summary: Preliminary U.S.-U.K. testing found Kimi K3 completed one of 10 simulated attack attempts but failed to make targets run attacker-chosen code in 41 exploit tests The post Open-weight AI model Kimi K3 completes simulated network attack appeared first on TechInformed .
